facts.fact: Seychelles Nation reports, from a ministry press release, that the Public Enterprise Monitoring Commission and the National Bureau of Statistics signed a memorandum of understanding to share information and streamline data collection from public enterprises; the signing date is not given.

The record-holder named in the Seychelles memorandum of understanding is the Public Enterprise Monitoring Commission, whose data from public enterprises is to be shared with the National Bureau of Statistics.

systems.owner: National Bureau of Statistics; Public Enterprise Monitoring Commission
